description: One of three ex-SAAF airframes displayed in the domestic area of AFB Langebaanweg, home of the Central Flying School. Three separate plinth-mounted airframes are visible on current Esri World Imagery around the main traffic circle, matching the three the SAAF list records here, but the imagery is only z18 and individual airframes could not be told apart, so no per-airframe coordinate is asserted. Marked FB.52 on the current SAAF list; the 2013 forum inventory called the same airframe a Vampire FB Mk 9. The discrepancy is unresolved.
aliases: Vampire FB.52;Vampire FB52;Vampire FB Mk 9;DH.100 Vampire;DH100 Vampire

description: Ex-Central Flying School basic jet trainer displayed in the domestic area of AFB Langebaanweg. Present in both the 2013 forum gate-guard inventory and the current Unofficial SAAF Website list. One of three plinth-mounted airframes visible on current Esri imagery around the base traffic circle; individual identification from imagery was not possible.
aliases: Impala Mk I;Impala Mk 1;Impala Mk1;Atlas Impala;Aermacchi MB-326M;Aermacchi MB326M

description: Ex-SAAF advanced trainer displayed at AFB Langebaanweg. Present in both the 2013 forum inventory and the current SAAF list. The airframe mounted on a plinth in the centre of the base traffic circle on current Esri imagery has a single-engine planform consistent with a Harvard, which makes it the most likely of the three to be this aircraft, but the resolution does not settle it.
aliases: Harvard Mk III;Harvard III;Harvard Mk 3;AT-6 Harvard;AT6 Harvard;T-6 Texan;T6 Texan
